|ingredients = {{Name|Cave Carrot|2}}{{Name|Sugar|1}}{{Name|Milk|1}} }} '''Miner's Treat''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. Miner's Treat can be purchased any day from the [[Dwarf]] for {{Price|1000}} or randomly from [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]]. [[Mummy|Mummies]] in the [[Skull Cavern]] have a 4% chance of dropping a Miner's Treat. 5 Miner's Treat may occasionally be found in a [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure room]] in the Skull Cavern. One Miner's Treat is a reward for submitting an [[Desert Festival#Skull Cavern|Egg Rating]] of 1-4 to [[Gil]] during the [[Desert Festival]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy |love=Maru |dislike=Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Miner's Treat is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== Miner's Treat is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Propeller Hat|class=inline}}. It can also serve as a red dye color at the dye pots at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== Miner's Treat is not used in any [[quests]]. ==History== {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}} {{History|1.5|Can now be prepared using a [[Cookout Kit]].}} {{History|1.6|Now obtainable from [[Desert Festival]].}} {{NavboxRecipes}} [[Category:Recipes]] [[Category:Cooking]] [[de:Bergarbeiter-Leckerbissen]] [[es:Capricho de minero]] [[fr:Friandise de mineur]] [[it:Gioia del minatore]] [[ja:マインキャンディ]] [[ko:광부의 간식]] [[hu:Bányászok eledele]] [[pt:Refeição de mineiro]] [[ru:«Шахтерский леденец»]] [[tr:Madenci Şekeri]] [[zh:矿工特供]]
